reason: Based on repository metadata and README, this plugin is primarily an orchestration and automation tool for agent capability management: it discovers skills/plugins, builds and maintains a searchable Chinese catalog, and optionally coordinates existing trusted installers when users explicitly request installation. It also provides CLI workflows for search/filter/diff/status tasks and updates local catalog/profile files, while not presenting independent code generation, data analytics, or media processing as its core function.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于扫描与维护已发现的技能与插件中文能力目录，并在用户明确要求时编排已有安装器以更新能力说明和安装状态。
summaries.en: This plugin manages a searchable catalog of discovered skills and plugins, and when requested by the user, orchestrates existing installers to update related capability documentation and install status.

capabilities: Local capability discovery and catalog generation/update
Filesystem read/write for local profile and catalog documents
Read-only metadata inspection from public repositories
Optional orchestration of existing installers when explicitly requested
Search/filter and status reporting over discovered skills/plugins

reasons.code: README states the primary function is to maintain a Chinese capability catalog and scan existing Codex/DSH skills and plugins.
